keywords: ERC-8262 零知识合规预言机
summary: 周六较安静。ERC-8262 零知识合规预言机提交，用户在交易时用零知识证明满足特定司法辖区的合规要求，而不暴露身份。tcoratger 解读 Justin Drake 关于量子威胁的报告，认为 2032 年前出现可破解密码的量子计算机的概率明显上升。

items.title: ERC-8262：零知识合规预言机
items.note: 07:32（Hydepwns），对应 ERCs #1747 提交：用户在交易时用证明表明符合特定司法辖区的要求，不暴露身份、不依赖 TEE 或可信第三方，监管方只检查证明，看不到交易本身。
items.note_en: 07:32 (Hydepwns), with ERCs #1747 submitted: users prove at transaction time that they meet a jurisdiction's requirements, with no identity revealed, no TEE and no trusted third party; a regulator checks the proof and never sees the trade.

summary_en: A quiet Saturday. ERC-8262, a zero-knowledge compliance oracle, was submitted: users prove at transaction time that they meet a jurisdiction's compliance rules without revealing identity. tcoratger broke down Justin Drake's presentation on the quantum threat, arguing the probability of a cryptographically relevant quantum computer before 2032 has risen sharply.
